actions.action: Scratch test the woody stalk to check if alive
Cut woody stalk back to just above a leafy node
If no leaves on stalk, cut it near the soil
Prune/pinch tips above leaf nodes regularly, max one third at a time
Pinch off flower buds as they appear
Root trimmings in a glass of water
Thin seedlings to strongest one or two
Start fresh plants from cuttings or seed as backup

reason: The answer identifies the woody, leggy basil from poor pruning and gives clear advice to cut back the stalk and prune above nodes, matching the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
